(async()=>{for(const [name,args] of [['control_draftsman',{expectedJobId:__mcpContext.projectId,action:'play'}],['control_draftsman',{expectedJobId:__mcpContext.projectId,action:'blueprint'}],['read_draftsman_status',{expectedJobId:__mcpContext.projectId}]]){const r=await __mcpApi.callAssistantTool(name,args,new AbortController().signal);if(!r.isError)throw Error('Unmounted/unsupported tool succeeded')}const c=await __callMcp('read_project_context',{});if(c.pane!=='sketch')throw Error('Implicit navigation');return {unmountedStatusAndControlRefused:true,noNavigation:true}})()

(async()=>{const ctl=new AbortController();ctl.abort();let rejected=false;try{await __mcpApi.callAssistantTool('draw_architect_elements',{expectedJobId:__mcpContext.projectId,expectedRevision:__mcpBefore.project.revision,operations:[{kind:'line',levelId:__mcpBefore.project.levels[0].id,a:[0,0],b:[1000,0]}]},ctl.signal)}catch{rejected=true}if(!rejected)throw Error('Aborted request executed');const p=(await __callMcp('read_architect_design',{expectedJobId:__mcpContext.projectId})).project;if(JSON.stringify(p)!==JSON.stringify(__mcpBefore.project))throw Error('Aborted request changed design');return {abortedBeforeDispatch:true,designUnchanged:true}})()

(async()=>{window.__mcpUndo=await __callMcp('read_architect_design',{expectedJobId:__mcpContext.projectId});for(const key of ['walls','openings','lines','roomTags','sheet','sheetSet'])if(JSON.stringify(__mcpUndo.project[key])!==JSON.stringify(__mcpBefore.project[key]))throw Error('Undo did not restore '+key);return {undoVerified:true,revision:__mcpUndo.project.revision}})()

(async()=>{window.__mcpApi=await import('/src/studio/assistant/session.ts');window.__mcp=await __mcpApi.getAssistantMcp();window.__callMcp=async(name,args)=>{const r=await __mcpApi.callAssistantTool(name,args,new AbortController().signal);if(r.isError)throw Error(JSON.stringify(r.content));return JSON.parse(r.content[0].text)};window.__mcpExpected=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('xray.qa.mcp.expected'));const c=await __callMcp('read_project_context',{});if(c.projectId!==__mcpExpected.id)throw Error('Project identity changed');await __callMcp('navigate_workspace',{expectedJobId:c.projectId,pane:'sketch'});return c})()
